title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Cypress is a startup building media apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is fully remote within the country.

Our stack: swift, kotlin. You will review code with the team, improve app performance and stability and own the release process.

A small, senior team. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
